doc_title_en: Notice of Revision of Full-Year Business Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for FY9/25
doc_title_jp: 通期業績予想の修正及び配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 当期純利益の予想数値の上方修正を踏まえ

summary_en: Annual dividend raised to ¥72/share from ¥70/share (+2.9%). Prior-year FY9/24 paid ¥67/share. Increase reflects upward revision of net income forecast to ¥2,277M (+¥187M from prior guidance). Payout ratio implied ~32%. Effective FY9/25 year-end, single interim payment at period close.
summary_jp: 年間配当を70円から72円に増額（+2.9%）。当期純利益予想を2,277百万円に上方修正（前回比+187百万円）を踏まえ。前期（FY9/24）は67円。配当性向32%。FY9/25期末に全額支払予定。
